facts.title: Jesus knew Judas would betray Him. So why did He keep him close?

items.msg: first VO line equals the title
33 words (max 25): 'Then He said it out loud: "One of you will betray me." And here's what most peop'

answer stated in the Turn/Landing: 'He gave the reason at that table, "the Scripture will be fulfilled," and He walked into it with His eyes open, treating Judas like the rest so evenly that when He said "one of you," they couldn't tell who it was. Love isn't blind: Jesus saw everything, and loved anyway. So when someone close turns on you: tell the truth plainly, let them go if they choose to go, and don't let it make you cold.'
